paras: 09 Days Jaipur-Bikaner-Jaisalmer-Jodhpur & Udaipur Tour Package
Tour Code #DR058
Rs.19299/- per person
Day 01 – Arrival in Jaipur
Jaipur also known as Pink City, it fascinates with its royal palaces, famous forts, and colorful markets. Experience the royal glory and cultural prosperity of Rajasthan's capital.

Upon arrival at Jaipur Railway Station/Airport, our representative will warmly welcome you and assist with your check-in at the hotel. After settling in and relaxing at the hotel, in the evening, we will visit some of the modern attractions of the Pink City:
Statue Circle: Symbolizing Jaipur's pride and heritage.
Birla Auditorium & Planetarium: Cultural hub with celestial wonders.
Vidhan Sabha: Heart of Rajasthan's legislative assembly.
Birla Mandir (Laxmi Narayan Temple): Marble serenity dedicated to Laxmi.
Jawahar Kala Kendra: Promoting arts and cultural exchange.
By the evening, indulge in the flavours of Rajasthan with a delightful Rajasthani dinner at a resort, accompanied by folk dance music and cultural performances set in a rustic village atmosphere.
Overnight stay at your hotel in Jaipur.
Day 02 – Jaipur Sightseeing
After a refreshing morning breakfast, embark on a journey to explore the historical wonders of the old Pink City:
Hawa Mahal: Palace of winds in Jaipur.
City Palace: Jaipur's royal residence marvel.
Observatory (Jantar Mantar): Ancient astronomical marvels in Jaipur.
Jal Mahal: Palace floating on Man Sagar.
Amer Fort: Guardian of Jaipur's majestic history.
Nahargarh Fort: Overlooking Jaipur's scenic beauty.
In the evening, enjoy the mesmerizing Light & Sound show at Amer Fort, a captivating display of Rajasthan's rich history and culture through lights and sound.
Overnight stay at your hotel in Jaipur.
Day 03 – Jaipur - Bikaner

After breakfast, check out from the hotel and proceed to Bikaner. Nestled in Rajasthan's Thar Desert, Bikaner awaits with its unique charm. Upon arrival, check-in at the hotel and visit the following attractions:
Junagarh Fort: Architectural marvel in Bikaner's heart.
Camel Breeding Farm: Nurturing Bikaner's ship of desert.
Karni Mata Temple: Home of rats revered religiously.
Overnight stay at your hotel in Bikaner.
Day 04 – Bikaner - Jaisalmer
Jaisalmer: The "Golden City" Jaisalmer mesmerizes with its yellow sandstone architecture and the magnificent Jaisalmer Fort. Experience desert safaris, ornate havelis, and a glimpse into desert life.
After breakfast, drive to Jaisalmer and check into the hotel. Freshen up and explore the Golden City's landmarks:
War Museum: Honouring Jaisalmer's heroic tales.
Gadisar Lake: Jaisalmer's serene water reservoir.
Vyas Chhatri: Remnants of Jaisalmer's architectural splendour.
Overnight stay at your hotel in Jaisalmer.
Day 05 – Sightseeing & Jaisalmer Desert
After breakfast, explore Jaisalmer's enchanting sights:
Jaisalmer Fort & Palaces: Guarding Jaisalmer's historical opulence.
Jain Temples: Spiritual sanctuaries in Jaisalmer's heart.
Patwon ki Haveli: Showcasing Jaisalmer's intricate craftsmanship.
Salim Singh ki Haveli: Architectural gem in Jaisalmer's desert.
Nathmal ki Haveli: Work of art in Jaisalmer.
Later in the day, experience the unique charm of the desert with an overnight stay in tents at the sand dunes, complete with cultural programs, camel rides, bonfires, sunset views, and dinner.
Overnight stay at Desert Camp in Jaisalmer.
Day 06 – Jaisalmer – Jodhpur Sightseeing
The "Blue City" Jodhpur boasts the majestic fort and a sea of blue houses. Discover its rich history, exciting shopping markets, and scenic views of the Thar Desert.
After breakfast at the desert camp, proceed to Jodhpur. Upon arrival and check-in at the hotel, explore the captivating attractions of the Blue City:
Umaid Bhawan Palace Museum: Wonder of Jodhpur's royal residence.
Jaswant Thada: Architectural tribute in Jodhpur.
Mehrangarh Fort: Guardian fort of Jodhpur's legacy.
Clock Tower & Markets: Heartbeat of Jodhpur.
Overnight stay at your hotel in Jodhpur.
Day 07 – Jodhpur - Ranakpur - Udaipur

After breakfast, journey towards Udaipur, stopping en route to visit the renowned Ranakpur Jain temples, renowned for their stunning architecture. Upon arrival in Udaipur, check-in at the hotel and relax.Udaipur also known as the "City of Lakes," it enchants with its serene waters, grand palaces, and romantic atmosphere. Visit the exquisite City Palace and enjoy a boat ride on Lake Pichola.
Overnight stay at your hotel in Udaipur.
Day 08 – Udaipur Sightseeing
After breakfast, explore every corner of Udaipur, the Lake City:
City Palace: Udaipur's splendor.
Jagdish Temple: Spiritual haven in Udaipur.
Bharatiya Lok Kala Mandal: Showcasing Udaipur's cultural heritage.
Pratap Smarak: Tribute to Udaipur's heroic history.
Shilp Gram: Craftsmanship epitome in Udaipur.
Bagore ki Haveli: Symbol of Udaipur's royal past.
Saheliyon kiBari: Garden of Udaipur's maidens.
Overnight stay at your hotel in Udaipur.
Day 09 – Udaipur Departure
After breakfast, it is time to bid farewell to Udaipur. Our representative will drop you off at the Udaipur Railway Station/Airport for your onward journey.
(The Tour Ends)
This itinerary ensures a seamless blend of history, culture, and natural beauty, offering an unforgettable experience of Rajasthan's rich heritage.
Package Inclusions:

* Driver allowance, fuel, parking fees, and all applicable taxes

09 Days Delhi-Agra-Jaipur-Ajmer/Pushkar-Udaipur-Mount Abu Tour Package
Tour Code #DR061
Rs.19999/- per person
Day 01: Arrival in Delhi

Upon your arrival at the Delhi Railway Station or Airport, our representative will warmly welcome you. Check in at your hotel and relax. Delhi is renowned for its tourist attractions, delectable food, and bustling marketplaces. Shopping is a must-do activity while exploring the city. As the capital of India, Delhi is rich in culture and heritage. Enjoy an overnight stay at your Delhi hotel.
Day 02: Delhi Sightseeing
After breakfast, we will embark on a tour to explore Delhi's stunning attractions:
Red Fort: Treasure of India.
Purana Quila (Old Fort): Antique ramparts, stories untold.
Jama Masjid: Spiritual echoes, architectural splendor.
Qutub Minar: Tower of history, soaring heights.
India Gate: Memorial pride, nation's remembrance.
Chandni Chowk: Marketplace melodies, Delhi's heartbeat.
Lakshmi Narayan Temple: Divine grace.
Return to your hotel for an overnight stay.
Day 03: Delhi to Agra
After breakfast, we will transfer to Agra. Check in at your hotel and relax. Later, we will visit:
Taj Mahal (symbol of love): Eternal love, carved in marble.
Agra Fort: Mughal grandeur, fortress of emperors.
Itimad-Ud-Daulah (Baby Taj): Jewel box of Mughal art.
Explore local markets and bazaars: A tapestry of culture.
Overnight stay at your Agra hotel.
Day 04: Agra to Jaipur
After breakfast, we'll proceed to Jaipur. Check in at your hotel and unwind. In the evening, we'll visit the modern attractions of the Pink City:
Statue Circle: Elegance etched in stone, serene.
Birla Auditorium & Planetarium: Celestial wonders, knowledge beneath stars.
Vidhan Sabha (Legislative Assembly): Heartbeat of democracy, laws resonate.
Birla Mandir (Temple): Divine grace in marble.
Jawahar Kala Kendra (Art Centre): Art's heart, creativity blooms here.
Enjoy a delicious Rajasthani dinner with folk music and cultural dance at a resort. Overnight stay at your Jaipur hotel.
Day 05: Jaipur Sightseeing
Jaipur also known as Pink City, it fascinates with its royal palaces, famous forts, and colorful markets. Experience the royal glory and cultural prosperity of Rajasthan's capital.
After breakfast, we will explore Jaipur's historic attractions:
Hawa Mahal (Palace of Winds): Whispers of history, breeze carries.
City Palace: Royal heritage, echoes of sovereignty.
Observatory / Jantar Mantar: Celestial precision, antique astronomers' marvel.
Jal Mahal (Water Palace): A Palace on water.
Amer Fort: Strength in stone, tales untold.
Nahargarh Fort: Guardian of the city, royal sentinel.
In the evening, enjoy the spectacular Light & Sound show at Amer Fort. Return to your hotel for an overnight stay.
Day 06: Jaipur to Ajmer, Pushkar, and Udaipur
After breakfast, we will head to Udaipur, stopping at Ajmer and Pushkar along the way. These are significant pilgrimage centers.
Ajmer: Dargah of Khwaja Muin-ud-din Chisti
Pushkar: Lord Brahma Temple
Continue to Udaipur and check in at your hotel. Overnight stay in Udaipur.
Day 07: Udaipur Sightseeing
After breakfast, we will visit Udaipur's beautiful sites:
City Palace: Regal opulence, lake vistas.
Jagdish Temple: Divine blessings, architectural marvel.
Bhartiya Lok Kala Mandal: Cultural showcase, folk art.
Pratap Smarak: Memorial valor, historical tribute.
Shilp Gram: Artisan's haven, rural crafts.
Bagore ki Haveli: Historical residence, cultural heritage.
Saheliyon ki Bari: Garden of maidens, serene retreat.
Overnight stay at your Udaipur hotel.
Day 08: Udaipur to Mount Abu

Mount Abu is Rajasthan's only hill station, Mount Abu offers a refreshing retreat with cool climate, lush greenery, and scenic viewpoints. Visit the famous Dilwara Temples and enjoy the peaceful Nakki Lake.
After breakfast, we will travel to Mount Abu and check in at your hotel. We will then visit Mount Abu's main attractions:
Delwara Temple: Architectural marvel, divine elegance.
Vedi Temple: Sacred sanctum, spiritual aura.
Nakki Lake: Peaceful waters, scenic beauty.
Sunset Point: Evening colors, panoramic view.
Toad Rock: Nature's sculpture, antique marvel.
Guru Shikhar: Peak serenity, spiritual heights.
Achalgarh Mahadev Temple: Historical splendor, religious fervor.
Brahma Kumari Ashram: Spiritual retreat, inner peace.
Overnight stay at your Mount Abu hotel.
Day 09: Departure from Mount Abu or Udaipur
After breakfast, you will be transferred to Mount Abu or Udaipur Railway Station or Airport for your departure. (Tour Ends)
